handoff: Changes requested: the logged-out park is undone ~60s later by Claude Code's idle notification (turn_end), which resolves the implicit ask while the session is still logged out, so nudges are spent anyway; the decide test covers only the first park.

findings.title: The idle notification that follows a failed login resolves the logged-out ask, so the nudges are still spent
findings.detail:
Spec Wanted: 'norn treats it like the usage-limit wait: a waiting_input implicit ask … with no nudges spent.' After StopFailure authentication_failed parks the unit (agent.ask.implicit), Claude Code returns to its input prompt; ~60 s later it fires Notification idle_prompt, which packages/adapters/src/claude/index.ts:53 maps to turn_end. The new STOP_FAILURE_EVENTS comment (index.ts:70) relies on this same idle notification to end the turn for other errors. implicitAskResolved (agent.ts:419) resolves an implicit ask on the first hook newer than park.since that is not waiting_input/permission_prompt, so story.ts:520-521 writes the 'moved on' answer and the run resumes. The session is still logged out: classifyRun (agent.ts:222-237) finds no wait as last hook and, after the stalled window, classifies agent.stalled → nudge; each nudge (UserPromptSubmit) gets another StopFailure park, then another idle → resolve, until the nudges run out and the unit goes stuck. The decide test 'a logged-out session parks on an implicit ask that says so, spending no nudge' (packages/core/test/unit/decide.test.ts:256) has only turn_start + StopFailure hooks, so it proves the happy path only.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Keep a logged-out park until a sign the session can act again: e.g. do not let an idle_prompt turn_end (or any turn_end/idle) resolve an implicit ask that a StopFailure raised, or drop the idle_prompt that directly follows a logged-out StopFailure in refineHooks. Add a decide test: turn_start, StopFailure waiting_input, park, then a later idle_prompt turn_end → the unit stays parked and nudges_used stays 0; and one where a later UserPromptSubmit does resolve it.
